I approved `paper-repo`#5 at its head, 77eea3b, so its merge no longer waits on me.

- **What I checked:** every figure and table file in the candidate is identical to my last delivery. In the built PDF, the in-sample line is called a reference in Fig. 2 and Fig. 9. The Table 8 caption states the once-per-pool majority rule for the transform choice. Tables 3 and 4 and the Fig. 5 caption name the logit-space real-data tier. The main text now says "Appendix Table N". There are no unresolved references (`??`) in the text.
- **Not rechecked:** page layout and font sizes, which I did not re-measure on this build.
- **One small fix after approval:** the Fig. 5 caption said "Table 4" where the main text says "Appendix Table 4". I changed it, and the caption still fits in 7 lines. It is pushed to `figtab-repo` `main` and to `paper-repo` `dev` as f62cc34, so the candidate does not have it yet. I told `paper-repo` in the review that it can take it in the next version.
